title: Ninja Swirl by Creami (NC701) $274.99 Delivered @ Ninja
body:
Deal: Ninja Swirl by Creami (NC701) $274.99 Delivered @ Ninja

[tomwhiteallnight] How does it compare against the Creami Deluxe? My wife really wants this for the soft ice cream, but it looks to me that the delux has many more functions.
[dmac80] I have the Deluxe. I think the pints are smaller in the swirl and obviously the Deluxe can't do soft serve.
[double_J] If you respin, you'll have scoopable soft serve.
[matbro999] If my soft serve had wheels it would be a bike
[Ryxxi] wrong, just respin.. also for the deluxe you can buy steel pints which freeze more evenly
[SupeNintendoChalmers] Not sure if I want to see JV in a bikini.
[SupeNintendoChalmers] At least out means my imagination won't run wild.
Small mercies
[hellrazorone] I'd prefer a pina colada or whatever I'd rather.
[sleepy120] Poor bikini would get eaten alive by anything that has unlimited soft serve cones on tap!
[banana365] Well thank you for that image, I wasn't planning on eating today anyway.
[DeepwaterNewt] I'm sure I saw this at CostCo in Canberra today for… $248?
[DeepwaterNewt] Nope, nevermind, it wasn't this model, it was just the plain ol' Ninja.
[sachz] NV701 great price!
I paid $360 during prime days.
At this price point id jump at it.
[meetshah1510] Can we price match it at the Good Guys and then use the 20% off Storecash coupon?
Thoughts on this or the product would be sold out before the morning and good guys would not honor the price !
[ToniGee] Storecash coupon cant be used with pricebeat unfortunately.
[myketa] Got one for 247.50 with Welcome10 10% extra off cheers.
[meetshah1510] Good guys has dropped the price to $275 and the 20% store cash works as well!
Just checked $220 for it!
[xhxxyx] I will head to the store tomorrow combine this with the $30 in store voucher
[meetshah1510] Anyone has an extra $30 coupon code and if they could help me please?
[gaber] Missed the creami deluxe sale and hoping it'll come back :(
